title: Share your story
description: Tell other students, organizations and universities what working through FursadHub was actually like.

form.title: Write your testimonial
form.moderationNotice: Submitting sends your words to the FursadHub team for review. Nothing appears on the public site until a moderator publishes it, and your words are published exactly as you wrote them or not at all.
form.displayNameHint: This is the name shown beside your quote. Your account email is never published.

errors.TESTIMONIAL_ALREADY_SUBMITTED: You already have a testimonial awaiting review or published.
errors.TESTIMONIAL_INVALID_TRANSITION: That testimonial cannot change state that way.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
errors.generic: Your testimonial could not be submitted. Try again.
errors.TESTIMONIAL_ROLE_NOT_ELIGIBLE: Your account does not yet have a FursadHub role we can attribute a story to.

form.sharingAsHint: FursadHub takes this from your account, so your story is always published under the role you really hold. It cannot be changed here.
